component.name: Ratewise
component.summary: View and set sound card sample rates, formats and buffer sizes

description.p: Ratewise shows what each sound card is running at right now (sample rate, format and buffer size) and what it supports, and changes those settings for PipeWire, WirePlumber, PulseAudio or plain ALSA.
Every change is shown as a plan with file diffs before it is applied, is backed up first, and can be reverted. It only writes your own config files and never needs root.

A redesigned window: a clearer overview with the running rate, depth and channels, a grid of supported sample rates, a new buffer-size slider, settings grouped into sections, and coloured file changes when reviewing a change.
Bluetooth headphones and headsets: switch between high quality and headset mode, pick the codec, set LDAC quality, and choose whether calls switch the headset automatically.
Opens on more systems: fixes for minimal installs with no fonts, a crash with a partly bundled keyboard library, and machines where OpenGL fails.
First release: device list, per-device and global settings, review and revert.
